item.title: FACEIT for MLBB: where to play serious 5v5 matches
item.description: There is no FACEIT for MLBB, but there are SKY, Lockin and MLBB Ladder: a queue, ELO, fixed roles and a game lobby. How they work and how to start.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
FACEIT has no Mobile Legends. Fan-made platforms took its place for MLBB: SKY, Lockin and MLBB Ladder.
They all work the same way: a queue on the site, ten players of a similar level, roles set in advance, a custom lobby in the game and an ELO rating.
You need your own MLBB account: the platforms check the ID and server, and you can play only from it.
Playing is free. SKY promises cash prizes for the top of its leaderboard, and CyberHero by t2 runs tournaments with prizes.
Why you need it
MLBB ranked counts stars, and random matchmaking builds the team: your jungler may skip Retribution and two fighters may end up in one lane. Competitive platforms work differently. The rating is ELO, so it grows when you beat strong opponents. Roles are fixed before the match, and AFK or throwing games is punished. It is FACEIT, as in CS2, only for a mobile MOBA, which is why people search for "FACEIT for MLBB".

SKY: the most detailed platform
SKY was opened by the streamer Geass, and its beta started on 18 November 2026. It is a platform for 5v5 rated matches: everyone starts at zero ELO, the first ten matches are calibration, then come levels from 1 to 10. Results come from the game automatically: the win, damage, gold, KDA and MVP. The rating depends not only on your team's win but on your own contribution.
The SKY home page, 26 November 2026.
Choose the preferred server with the lowest ping: each server has its own queue.
Tick the roles you are ready to play and start the search.
When a match is found, you have 45 seconds to accept. Missing it blocks the search: 2 minutes at first, longer for repeats the same day.
The host creates a custom lobby from the link in the match card within 6 minutes, on the Mythic Battlefield map.
Everyone else joins and takes their side, blue or red, as on the site.
You play the role the site assigned. You can swap only if the player you swap with agrees.
Besides the regular mode there is a draft: two captains play rock-paper-scissors and pick players in turns, one for each role. It unlocks at 1531 ELO. There are also one-on-one duels with their own rating and class bans. Every finished match adds conduct points. Below 90 the search takes longer. A confirmed AFK costs 10 points, a violation 20.
A ping up to 60 ms counts as normal, and the match is played out. If it is higher, you can request a rehost in the first 2 minutes; it needs 7 votes out of 10. Surrendering instead of a rehost counts as a loss.
Ping and rehost
Playing is free. A three-tier Premium subscription gives cosmetics and conveniences and is paid in the in-house G-Coin currency, one G-Coin is one rouble. In its announcement SKY promises cash prizes for the top of the leaderboard, games with esports players, a pro league and mixes. Registration is from 14 years old.
Lockin: Telegram sign-in and a strict check
Lockin is made by enthusiasts who want points-based rating back, like the old PTS system. You sign in with one click through Telegram. The platform gets only your ID, name, username and profile photo, not your phone number or chats. The MLBB account is confirmed by ID and server, so smurfs will not get in.
The Lockin home page, 26 November 2026.
Sign in through Telegram.
Enter your MLBB account ID and server.
Pick a role: jungle, EXP, mid, gold or roam. You play it in the match, no lane arguments.
Join the queue. The longer you wait, the wider the rating range of your opponents.
Confirm you are ready and join the lobby from the link.
The ten players are split into teams with one per role so that the total rating of both sides is nearly equal. Beating stronger players gives more points. Matchmaking for full five-stacks is promised once there are enough players. On 26 November the leader of the table had 1574 points. The Lockin app is downloaded from their Telegram channel.
If the lobby link opens the app store, hold it, copy it and paste it into the browser. If that fails, ask for the lobby code in the match chat. If the result has not arrived within a minute, press Call admin.
The link opens Google Play
MLBB Ladder
MLBB Ladder is another fan-made 5v5 matchmaking. The site gathers ten players and splits them into two equal teams by ELO and role. There are levels from 1 to 10, seasons, tops by role and hero, profiles and match history. Sign-in needs no password, it goes through a Telegram bot. The site sits behind DDoS protection, so the browser sometimes asks you to pass a check first.
Tournaments with prizes
If you want money for results right now rather than a leaderboard, look at CyberHero by the operator t2. It runs one-on-one MLBB knockout tournaments almost every day. For example, on the weekend of 28 and 29 November 2026 there is the Solo Weekend Premium Cup with a prize pool of 10,000 roubles. The site is 18+.
Before your first match
Find your account ID and server: you will be asked for them at the check.
Decide which roles you are ready to play: the role is fixed before the match and you cannot leave it without consent.
Check your connection: on SKY a ping above 60 ms is already a reason for a rehost.
Play only from your own account. Every platform bans playing for someone else, and on SKY the account is bound for good.
Do not accept a match if you are not ready to finish it: missed matches lead to longer search blocks.

item.title: MLBB server, region and ID: how to find and change them
item.description: Your ID and server are on your profile. The account server never changes; the leaderboard region is your GPS location and changes once a season.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
Your ID and server are on your profile: the first number is the ID, the number in brackets is the server. For example, 123456789 (1234).
You cannot move an account to another server. MOONTON does not transfer accounts; another server means a new account from scratch.
The region on the leaderboard is your phone's GPS location. You can change it once per season, then play 1 match with the hero.
You can fake the location on Android with a mock location app, on iPhone only with a computer. It bends the game rules, at your own risk.
How to find your ID and server
A Mobile Legends account has two numbers. The ID is your player number and never changes. The server, also called Zone ID or Server ID, is the server your account was created on. The profile shows them on one line: the ID first, then the server in brackets.
On the main screen, tap your avatar in the top left corner.
Under your name, find the ID line: the long number is the ID, the number in brackets is the server.
Copy it with the button next to it, so you do not mistype a digit.
Where to find your ID
Where you need the ID and server
Where
What to enter
Buying diamonds in a top-up shop
ID and server in separate fields, no password
Contacting MOONTON support
ID, server and name
Competitive match platforms
ID and server to verify the account
Finding a friend
Player ID
Most often the server is wrong. The number in brackets is not part of the ID: shops have a separate field for it. Before paying, check that the name the shop shows is yours.
If diamonds did not arrive
Can you change your account's server
No. The server is fixed when the account is created, and the game has no button to move it. Advice like "turn on a VPN and the number in brackets will change" only works for a new account: on the first launch the game detects the region again, while the old account stays on its server.
If you really need another region, for example to play with friends in Asia, the only way is a new account. Heroes, skins, rank and diamonds do not carry over. Mind the ping: the farther the server, the longer the delay in fights.
How to bind and switch an MLBB account
Before a new account
Bind your old account so you do not lose it when you switch.
The region on the leaderboard
Most people searching for "change region" mean the hero leaderboard. It has levels: the whole world, your country, city, district and a small area around you, plus a separate tab for your server. Your place in each of them depends on the hero's power, and power grows with ranked wins on that hero.
The hero leaderboard. The author's city, district and name are hidden.
Once a week the game counts the results and gives titles to the best players of each hero in a district, a region and a country. The title shows on your profile and on the match loading screen; the highest one goes to the top ten in a country. The fewer people play your hero near you, the easier it is to get into the top. That is why players move their location to small cities.
At the bottom of the leaderboard the game shows the approximate score needed to be ranked. If your power is below that number, you will not get into the current tab, wherever the pin is.
How much power you need
How to change the location in the game
Turn on location services and allow them for Mobile Legends.
Open the leaderboard and pick the hero.
Tap the location pin icon in the top right corner.
The game opens a map and detects your position by GPS.
Check the address in the Note window and tap OK.
Play a match with this hero to get into the new district's leaderboard.
The confirmation window. The author's address is hidden.
The confirmation window says it plainly: after the change you cannot change the location again this season. Older guides say once every seven days, but the 2026 client has a different rule. Pick the city in advance.
Once a season
How to change the location on Android
The game reads coordinates from GPS, not from the IP address, so a VPN alone will not change the city. On Android you can set any point with a mock location app. That is how players move the pin to another city without leaving home.
Install a mock location app from Google Play, for example Fake GPS Location.
Turn on developer mode: Settings → About phone → tap Build number seven times. On Xiaomi it is OS version, on Samsung Software information → Build number.
In Developer options, open Select mock location app and choose the app you installed.
Open it, put the point in the city you want and start it.
Close Mobile Legends completely by swiping it away from recent apps, then launch it again.
Open the leaderboard, tap the location icon and wait for the new city on the map. Confirm with OK.
Play a match with the hero and only then turn the mock location off.
Turn off improved location accuracy by Wi‑Fi and mobile network in the location settings: the phone then takes coordinates only from GPS. Check again that the right app is selected in developer mode.
If the game sees the old city
Faking the location bends the game rules. MOONTON may penalise third-party tools, up to a ban. We found no reports of mass bans for changing the location, but nobody gives guarantees.
Risk
What about iPhone?
The App Store has no apps that fake the location. Only computer programs work: you connect the iPhone with a cable and the program sets the coordinates. The free option is the virtual location feature in 3uTools; paid alternatives exist too. It is harder than on Android and carries the same risk. The honest way without programs is to change the location when you are actually in another city.
Where to put the pin
Raise the hero's power first. Without it there is no top in any city, and you cannot change the location twice in one season.
Watch the approximate score needed to be ranked: the lower it is, the fewer rivals.
A small city or district is usually easier than a capital, but you still have to hold the title every week.
Do not jump to another country: the highest title is per country, and another country may be stronger than yours.
MMR boost on a specific hero
Hero boost
Rank and rating of the hero you choose for the leaderboard.
The MLBB test server
There is also a separate test server, the Advanced Server: new heroes and changes appear there first. According to guides, you need an account of level 15 or higher and a stable connection, slots are few and recruitment is mostly in Asia. You apply in the account settings in the game or through a separate app on TapTap for Android. Progress there is separate, from level 1, and does not carry over to the regular server.

item.title: Mobile Legends not working? Fix launch, connection and lag issues
item.description: Find the fix for your symptom, whether MLBB crashes at launch, gets stuck on the loading screen, shows a network error or lags in matches.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
Stuck loading or seeing a network error? Close the game and retry on a different connection. Compare Wi‑Fi and mobile data on the same phone.
Crashing before the lobby? Restart your phone, check for updates and make sure you have space. On Android, start by clearing the cache.
Lobby works but matches lag? Compare ping and frame smoothness in Practice mode. Make sure you can sign back in before deleting the app or clearing its data.
What to check first
Match the symptom to the first check
Symptom
First check
Closes immediately at launch
Restart the phone. Open the game in your app store and check for an update.
Stuck on the splash screen or showing a network error
Try launching once on Wi‑Fi and once on mobile data.
Game opens but the account won’t sign in
Check which sign-in method you linked and record the exact error message.
Only matches lag
Check ping and frame smoothness in Practice mode.
Update download stalls
In the app store, check the connection and storage. If the download is inside the game, close it and try a different connection.
Network errors, endless loading and regional access
Close MLBB fully. Check whether a normal website loads on the same connection. If that fails too, troubleshoot the connection itself first.
Switch between Wi‑Fi and mobile data and reopen the game. Change only the connection for this comparison. If you already use a VPN, proxy or DNS filter, test its effect in a separate attempt.
Compare the results. If MLBB works on only one connection, record which one fails. If both fail the same way, check for an update and see whether another player on a different network gets the same error.
If you see a region availability warning, check whether it comes from your app store or from MLBB. Save the exact message. A store installation warning and a failure to connect to a match need different checks.
If several players on different devices and networks report the same error, check the game’s announcements. Reports can reveal a spike. Look for a MOONTON statement before attributing it to a specific cause.
How to spot a wider outage
Mobile Legends news
Game announcements
Check whether MOONTON has announced maintenance or an update.
What to do if the app crashes on Android or iPhone
On Android, open system settings, find Mobile Legends in the app list and open its storage settings. Choose Clear cache. Menu labels vary by device. Clear data and Clear storage erase local app data, including settings and saved sign-in state. Save those for later, once you know you can sign back in.
On iPhone, close the game, restart the device and check the App Store for updates. If the store download stalls, check free space and Apple’s troubleshooting steps. Delete the app for a reinstall only after confirming access to the linked account.
Apple’s download and update checks
App Store
Official steps for iPhone and iPad.
Bind or recover your MLBB account
If sign-in is the issue
Check your sign-in method before deleting the app.
How to tell high ping from low FPS
Signs of network lag and frame drops
In-match symptom
What to try in Practice mode
Inputs arrive late, the hero jumps across the map or the game reconnects
Compare ping on both networks. Pause other downloads and updates.
The picture stutters, the phone heats up and ping stays stable
Lower graphics quality or the frame-rate setting by one step. Compare in a similar scene.
Problems only occur with a particular party
Compare solo and party play on the same device and connection. If it repeats, save the match ID.
If your version offers a network test in Settings, run it from the lobby. Repeat it on the same connection just before a match. Test any network-boost option separately and compare results. Depending on the mode, it may use mobile data.
What to send to MOONTON support
Use in-game support if you can open the lobby. If you cannot reach it, the publisher lists mobilelegendsgame@moonton.com. Include the time and time zone, exact error, phone model, game version and what happened on each connection. If it happened in a match, include the match ID. Leave out your password and verification codes.

item.title: Mobile Legends emblems and talents: what to upgrade and how to choose
item.description: Spend fragments where they help, match the emblem to your lane and choose three talents. See examples for Miya, Nolan, Vexana, Tigreal and more.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
The Common Emblem is enough to start. Once you have a main hero pool, upgrade the set you use most often on those heroes.
Assassin is a first candidate for junglers and burst heroes. Start with Mage for mid and choose between Tank and Support for roam.
One emblem provides base stats. You also select 3 talents, one from each row. Once unlocked, talents can be used with other emblems.
Which emblem should you upgrade first?
Pick the heroes you play most and inspect their emblems in Preparation or on their hero pages. If several benefit from the same base stats, put your shared resources there.
Use the Common Emblem while trying different roles. Unlock talents in other sets as you settle on your main heroes.
Spend set-specific fragments on their matching set. Use shared Magic Dust to unlock a talent you need or to strengthen an emblem you equip regularly.
Check the emblem screen before upgrading. It shows what the next level adds and where the talent you want unlocks. Use that to decide whether to max one set or invest in another.
All 7 emblems and what each is for
Emblem sets and typical uses
Emblem
When to use it
Common
For resource regeneration, extra health and a flexible starting point.
Assassin
For penetration and mobility. It can also suit magic-damage heroes who rely on a short burst combo.
Mage
When the build relies on magic power, magic penetration and shorter skill cooldowns.
Fighter
For extended trades on skill-based heroes who benefit from spell vamp.
Tank
When you take the first hit and need health and hybrid defense.
Support
When the hero heals or protects allies and benefits from cooldown reduction.
Marksman
When frequent basic attacks deliver most of your damage and you need attack speed.
How to choose three talents for your hero
In the first row, pick a stat that fits how the hero attacks. Swift helps when you need attack speed. Rupture helps when you need penetration.
In the second row, choose an effect for the job you do. Seasoned Hunter helps a jungler contest neutral objectives. Wilderness Blessing suits roamers who spend time in the river and jungle.
In the third row, read the trigger. Lethal Ignition suits quick burst combos. Focusing Mark fits heroes who regularly tag a target for teammates to follow up on.
Open Preparation from the lobby and inspect your available emblems and talents. Save the build on the hero you plan to play and check it before the match. If a talent is greyed out, open its card to see the unlock requirement.

item.title: MLBB StarLight: price, rewards and every skin by month
item.description: In November 2026 it is Kalea "Tideborn Sailor" for 300 Diamonds. Here are all 120 skins since 2016 and what else the pass gives.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
StarLight costs 300 Diamonds a month, the Plus version 750.
The November 2026 skin is Kalea "Tideborn Sailor". The wiki list has Suyou "Frostblade Duelist" for December; MOONTON has not confirmed it yet.
Besides the skin, members get +10 Protection Points for every ranked loss and access to the StarLight Shop.
Since December 2016 there have been 120 skins. 108 of the 133 heroes got one, while 25 heroes, Marcel and Hirara among them, never have.
StarLight is a paid pass for one month. It opens on the 1st at 00:00 server time and gives the skin of the month at once. The other rewards come over 60 levels that grow with matches and tasks. At the end of the month the skin leaves the pass page, and tasks, levels and the shop reset.

Plus costs 450 Diamonds more. In return it gives 1,500 StarLight points, which is 15 levels at once, and 10% more points for the rest of the month. If you play almost every day, level 60 is reachable with the regular pass: for the first three weeks tasks open up to 18 levels a week, and the last week has no cap. Plus only pays off if you start near the end of the month.
What you get besides the skin
+10 Protection Points for every ranked loss.
10% more EXP, 5% more Battle Points and 30% more Mastery Points per match.

Access to the StarLight Shop, where fragments buy skins from past months.
The Protection Points matter more than the skin. The star protection bar fills faster, so a losing streak costs fewer stars. Our ranks guide explains how protection and stars work.

How to get a skin from a past month
Through the StarLight Shop. Since November 2026 MOONTON has added returning skins and Returning StarLight Packs there. According to GamingOnPhone, a regular old skin costs 3,000 StarLight Fragments and an Annual StarLight skin 5,000. A month of the pass brings from about 920 to 1,120 fragments, so one skin takes roughly three months. The exchange is open only to players who hold the pass in the current month.

Since 2019 MLBB has had 14 collaborations and 61 skins from other universes, from The King of Fighters to Street Fighter 6.
In 2025 a free collaboration skin came with the year-end Friend Fest event: Cyclops "SpongeBob".
According to Pinoy Gamer, Friend Fest 2026 starts on 4 December together with Avatar: The Last Airbender, and Zilong "Aang" will be free. MOONTON has not published a press release yet.
Chou has the most collaboration skins: four. Dyrroth, Julian and Valir have three each.

item.title: Mobile Legends account: how to bind, switch and recover it
item.description: Check your linked login in Account before switching phones. A guest profile may stay on the old device.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In brief
A guest account with no binding cannot be moved to another phone or restored after you delete the game. MOONTON’s terms say so directly.
You can bind the game to a Moonton account by email or to a Google, Apple ID, Facebook, TikTok or VK login.
Everything lives in the profile: Account → Account Center. That is where you bind, switch profiles, unbind social logins and delete.
If you do not log in for more than 6 months, MOONTON may delete the account along with its diamonds and skins.
Guest account
If you have never bound your account, you are playing on a guest profile that lives only on your phone. MOONTON’s terms of 21 October 2025 say that guest progress cannot be transferred, purchases cannot be restored after a reinstall, and deleting the game wipes the data for good. MOONTON does not guarantee recovery of such an account and recommends creating a Moonton account or binding a third-party login.
Open your profile, then Account → Account Center. If no login method is marked as bound, you are on a guest profile. Bind at least one method before you change phones.
Check it now
How to bind your account
Tap the avatar in the top-left corner of the main screen.
Open Account and choose Account Center.
Pick a login method. A Moonton account needs a working email: you receive a code there, then set a password.
For Google, Apple ID, Facebook, TikTok or VK, sign in to that account and confirm access.
Go back to Account Center and check that the method is marked as bound.
Where to bind the account
Which login method to choose
Method
What you need
When it fits
Moonton account
Email and password
The main method: it does not depend on social networks or your phone
Google
A Google account

Apple ID

iPhone and iPad
Facebook, TikTok, VK
An active social account
A backup: if the social account is blocked or deleted, you cannot log in through it
It is safer to bind two methods at once: a Moonton account plus Google or Apple ID. ONE Esports, in its account security guide, also recommends relying on a Moonton account and unbinding extra third-party logins.
How to switch accounts
A second profile is created on the same phone; you do not need to delete the game. Reinstalling does not help: on iPhone the game opens the old account again. Before switching, make sure your main account is bound, or you will not be able to return to it.
Open your profile, go to Account and tap the switch button (Switch Account in the English client).
Log in with the method bound to the other account, or register a new Moonton account with a different email.
To go back, tap Switch Account again and log in with the method bound to your main profile.
How to recover your account
Start simple: log in with the method the account was bound to. If logging in with Google or VK opens a new empty profile, that method is bound to a different account or there was no binding at all.
Log in with your Moonton account, Google, Apple ID, Facebook, TikTok or VK. A Moonton password is reset with a code sent to the bound email.
If nothing was bound, open Account Center and choose account recovery (Retrieve Account). AFK Gaming describes a check based on in-game details: the old account ID, server number and nickname.
If that fails, contact support from the game: the support icon is in your profile. Give your ID, the server number in brackets, nickname, roughly when the account was created and what you bought on it.
Sites and people who offer to recover or unban an account for money are scammers. Accounts are recovered only through the game and MOONTON support, and MOONTON never asks for your password for codes or gifts.
Be careful
How to delete your account
Deleting the game from your phone does not delete the account: a bound profile stays on MOONTON’s servers. According to the cyber.sports.ru guide, deletion takes two steps: in Account Center you unbind third-party logins and tap Delete Account, then the game opens play.mobilelegends.com, where you accept the agreements, log in and confirm with the Confirm to Cancel button.
The account is not deleted at once: the request waits up to 30 days, and logging in during that time offers a Give Up button that cancels the deletion.
After deletion your rank, heroes, skins and diamonds are gone. They cannot be restored.
According to cyber.sports.ru, the same email and social accounts cannot be bound to a new account afterwards.
A request to delete personal data under MOONTON’s privacy policy goes to dpo@moonton.com.
If you just want a clean profile, you do not have to delete the old one: create a second one with Switch Account.
What happens to an abandoned account
Under MOONTON’s terms an account nobody has logged in to for more than 6 months may be deleted or deactivated, and its diamonds and items are lost without compensation. If you have taken a break from the game, log in at least once every few months.

The official form never asks for your password, email or Moonton ID details. If a “free diamonds” site asks you to log in, close it: that is how accounts get stolen.
Safety
Why a redeem code does not work
The code has expired. Every code has its own deadline, after which it is no longer accepted.
The code has run out. Many codes have a limited number of activations.
The code was already used on this account. The same code will not work twice.

Where to find codes
MOONTON hands out real codes itself: in the game’s official communities, during major tournaments and at special events. If a code appears on a list site without a link to its source, check the date and never enter it anywhere except mobilelegends.com/redeem. Services that “generate” codes or diamonds do not exist.
We do not publish code lists: a code cannot be checked without redeeming it on your own account, and outdated lists only waste time. If MOONTON releases a code for all players, we will cover it in the news with a link to the source.

In short
The current MLBB patch is 2.2.16. It came out on 16 September 2026 together with the start of Season 42.
For the game’s 10th anniversary Masha and Bruno were reworked, and six more heroes got new models: Paquito, Kadita, Clint, Luo Yi, Brody and Badang.
Aulus, Argus, Aldous and Lukas were buffed; Miya, Hanabi, Melissa, Yi Sun-shin and Paquito were nerfed.
The next major patch is expected with Season 43: the last two arrived on the first day of a season, 17 June and 16 September.

The rework landed harder than expected: Masha now has the highest win rate in the game at 60.47%. Argus climbed to 56.76% after his buff. Hanabi was nerfed but is still the most picked hero and wins 52.64%. Tigreal got a shorter cooldown on his second skill, yet his win rate remains one of the lowest at 45.20%.
The new Masha and the new Bruno
Masha is now a berserker fighter built for long fights rather than an assassin for split-pushing. She still has three HP bars, and attacking from the side of the wound she left triggers Feral: three wide claw strikes plus Resilience, Attack Speed and Movement Speed.
Masha’s second skill resets its cooldown each time she loses one of her lives.
Bruno keeps his ball-kicking marksman style, but the ball is easier to control: its distance scales with Movement Speed, it stays on the ground for 3 seconds instead of 2 and no longer crosses walls.

Economy and map
Gold from the Horned Lizard, Fire Beetle and Lava Golem is down 13%.
The comeback kill bounty now triggers at a 1500 gold deficit instead of 2000.
Minion gold grows a little more slowly over time.
Since 28 September the annual map update is live: vision wisps reveal hidden enemies, the Turtle spawns an allied turtle on a lane instead of a shield, and destroying turrets gives the whole team much more gold.
MOONTON says matches were too fast and teams that fell behind struggled to come back. In ranked this means a gold lead is less safe: games more often go the distance, and late-game mistakes cost more.

The Season 42 skin is Flamehide Thane for Popol and Kupa, and the avatar border is Starward Decade.

The last two major updates, 2.1.88 (17 June) and 2.2.16 (16 September), arrived on the day a new season started. item.title: Mobile Legends ranks in order: all tiers, stars and Mythic
item.description: Mythic takes 112 stars to reach. Mythical Honor begins at 25 Mythic stars, Glory at 50 and Immortal at 100.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
In short
Mobile Legends has 10 ranks: Warrior, Elite, Master, Grandmaster, Epic, Legend, Mythic, Mythical Honor, Mythical Glory and Mythical Immortal.
You need 112 stars to reach Mythic, most of them in Grandmaster, Epic and Legend — 25 each.
Mythic has no divisions: Honor starts at 25 stars, Glory at 50 and Immortal at 100.
The first 10 Mythic matches are placement: a win gives two stars and a loss removes none.
Before Mythic, divisions run from III or V to I. Each takes 3 to 5 stars. In Mythic, all stars go towards one total.

The first ranks are the shortest: Warrior takes 9 stars and Elite 12. The real work starts in Grandmaster: three ranks in a row with 25 stars each, and that is where new players most often get stuck.
Mythic ranks and placement
After Legend I the next win takes you to Mythic. Placement starts here: 10 matches where every win gives two stars and a loss takes none. After that stars again change by one per win or loss.

Stars add up with no cap
Out of 2,289 orders BOOST MLBB has completed since November 2025, 569 were stars inside Mythical Immortal and 343 inside Mythical Glory. The most common route between ranks is Glory to Immortal: 179 orders.
Where our customers play
How stars are gained and lost
A ranked win adds one star and a loss removes one.
The star protection bar fills up when you play well. When it is full, your next loss does not cost a star.
In Epic and Legend good matches also build star raising points: when the bar fills, you get an extra star.
In Mythic placement a win gives two stars, and a loss uses a match but removes no stars.
Matches to reach Mythic
Win rate decides everything. At 50% wins your stars barely move: losses cancel the wins, and only star protection pushes you forward. Every extra five percent of wins cuts the road several times. We estimated the number of matches including star protection and placement.

item.description: Season 42 is expected to end on 16 December. Mythical Glory and Immortal drop to Legend V after the reset.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team

In short
Season 42 is expected to end on 16 December 2026. Moonton has not announced the date in advance; it is estimated from past season lengths.
At the reset Mythical Immortal and Mythical Glory drop to Legend V, Mythical Honor to Epic I and Mythic to Epic II.
Season rewards follow the highest rank you reached during the season, not your rank on the last day.
To get the season skin you need to play 20 ranked matches.
The season started on 16 September. The 16 December estimate is based on previous seasons lasting about 91 days. Check the ranked mode timer for the in-game countdown.

Below Legend the reset is softer — Epic drops one or two divisions, and Warrior and Elite do not drop.
Which rewards a season gives
The reward follows the highest rank you reached during the season. If you were Mythic and fell back to Legend, you still get the Mythic reward.
The Season 42 skin is Flamehide Thane for Popol and Kupa. It requires 20 ranked matches.
Battle Points and tickets are given at every rank, and the amount grows with the rank.
The first week of a new season is the busiest. In the week Season 42 started, BOOST MLBB customers placed 102 orders against 30–40 in a normal summer week. Season 41 looked the same: 67 orders in its first week. Players want their rank back fast, and fewer boosters are free on those days.

If you are a few stars short of the next rank, get them before 15 December — the reward follows your highest rank.
Finish 20 ranked matches if you have not yet and want the season skin.
If you plan a boost after the reset, order on the first day: the queue grows after that.
